t: The Manrose MF100 inline extractor fan is a robust ventilation unit, engineered for effective air extraction in both domestic and commercial properties. Constructed from resilient ABS plastic, this mixed flow fan offers two speed settings for adaptable performance and boasts an impressive 245 m³/hr extraction rate. It is ideal for installation within a loft or ceiling void, effectively clearing humidity and odours. Operating at a quiet 24dBA at 3m, with an IPX4 rating and overload protection, this fan ensures reliable, safe, and efficient air management.
b: Mount in Loft or Ceiling Void
